descriptor: Team workspace with three pricing plans

voice.summary: Sounds like a pricing page written by someone who hates hidden fees: clear, a touch cheeky and generous with specifics. Plans are explained by what the team can do, with limits stated up front.
dos: State price, limits and billing period together
Say what the free trial includes
donts: Do not hide limits in tooltips only
Do not use contact-sales as a wall
Do not make 20% savings sound like a catch

taglines: Pricing that scales with your team
Pick a plan, change it any time
Every feature, every plan, laid out
boilerplate: Cadence Cloud is a team workspace sold on three plans, Starter, Team and Scale, each with unlimited projects, a 14-day trial and a clear comparison of every feature.

microcopy.error: We couldn't start your trial. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No plan matches yet. Adjust team size.

logo.note: A cloud shape fits a hosted workspace and the product name.
